analyst.summary: DCM Shriram reported a very large jump in profit this quarter, but most of that jump came from one-time items -- gains on selling some assets and, most significantly, a large one-time tax benefit following a favourable tax tribunal ruling -- rather than from the underlying business suddenly becoming far more profitable. Looking past those one-off items, the core business is still growing at a healthy, genuine pace, led by strong performance in the chemicals division. Given that solid underlying growth and a reasonable valuation, we view this as a hold.
